items.text: Overpriced shop-bought sandwiches, underwhelming food from your work canteen or pricey local restaurants.
If those are the alternatives, then it's unsurprising that many of us think leftovers make the perfect lunch.

level1.label: 宾语从句
level1.text: that many of us think leftovers make the perfect lunch

items.text: Leftovers are a good way to cut down on food waste.

level1.label: 表语
level1.text: a good way to cut down on food waste

level2.label: 后置定语
level2.text: to cut down on food waste

items.text: If you've cooked them yourself, then you can be sure what all the ingredients are and where they've come from.
But how safe are leftovers?
Could there be a danger lurking in your lunchbox?

level1.label: 主语
level1.text: a danger lurking in your lunchbox

items.text: It's not just you that loves your leftovers.

level1.label: 表语
level1.text: not just you that loves your leftovers

items.text: The BBC's Trust Me, I'm a Doctor programme tells us that they are also great for bacteria like listeria, salmonella and campylobacter.

level1.label: 主语
level1.text: The BBC's Trust Me, I'm a Doctor programme

level1.label: 宾语从句
level1.text: that they are also great for bacteria like listeria, salmonella and campylobacter

items.text: They can nourish themselves on the food we love and multiply incredibly quickly.
One campylobacter bacterium can multiply to 70,000 million bacteria in just 12 hours.
Food poisoning caused by these bacteria usually makes people mildly unwell but can also cause more serious life-threatening illnesses.

level1.label: 主语
level1.text: Food poisoning caused by these bacteria

items.text: What do we need to think about to keep our leftovers safe?
Temperature control is important to stop bacteria growing on your food.

level1.label: 表语
level1.text: important to stop bacteria growing on your food

items.text: Food safety experts warn of a danger zone between 8C and 63C.
At these temperatures bacteria can grow easily on your leftover food.
Refrigerating your leftovers slows bacteria growth, and this is why experts recommend putting your leftover food in the fridge within two hours.

level1.label: 表语从句
level1.text: why experts recommend putting your leftover food in the fridge within two hours

items.text: You should also cover any food in the refrigerator because air can contain contaminants, and also, many pathogens need oxygen to grow.
However, do remember that fridges only slow bacteria growth, not stop it, so most leftovers should only be left in the fridge for two days.

level1.label: 宾语从句
level1.text: that fridges only slow bacteria growth, not stop it

items.text: Temperature is also important if you are reheating leftovers.
Instructions often recommend heating food until it's piping hot or steaming hot throughout.

level1.label: 宾语
level1.text: heating food until it's piping hot or steaming hot throughout

level2.label: 时间状语从句
level2.text: until it's piping hot or steaming hot throughout

items.text: Clinical microbiology lecturer Primrose Freestone recommends that ovens are set to at least 163C and that food's internal temperature should reach at least 74C.

level1.label: 宾语从句
level1.text: that ovens are set to at least 163C

level1.label: 宾语从句
level1.text: that food's internal temperature should reach at least 74C.

items.text: Other experts tell us that food heated in the microwave should be stirred halfway through the process so that it's cooked all the way through.

level1.label: 宾语从句
level1.text: that food heated in the microwave should be stirred halfway through the process so that it's cooked all the way through

level2.label: 结果状语从句
level2.text: so that it's cooked all the way through

items.text: Leftovers can be an economical way to cut down on food waste.

level1.label: 表语
level1.text: an economical way to cut down on food waste

level2.label: 后置定语
level2.text: to cut down on food waste

items.text: However, it's important that we store and reheat food carefully to make sure that it stays safe to eat.

level1.label: 宾语从句
level1.text: that we store and reheat food carefully to make sure that it stays safe to eat

level2.label: 状语
level2.text: to make sure that it stays safe to eat
